name: Wyze Cam Pan v4 (US)

radios.note: Dual-band 2.4 and 5 GHz, up to Wi-Fi 6.

matter.note: Neither Wyze page mentions Matter and no CSA listing was checked. Absence is not a no.

apple_home.note: Wyze's pages for this camera don't mention Apple Home or HomeKit.

google_home.note: Wyze lists Google Assistant as an integration.

alexa.note: Wyze lists Alexa as an integration.

smartthings.note: Wyze's pages for this camera don't mention SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: No official Home Assistant or Wyze page confirming this model was found.

hubRequired.note: Wyze's setup steps connect the camera straight to a 2.4 or 5 GHz home Wi-Fi network in the Wyze app; no base station is mentioned.

localControl.note: Wyze's pages don't say whether live view or control works without its cloud, and don't mention RTSP.

cameraType.note: Wyze markets it as 'Indoor/Outdoor compatible' with an asterisk and rates it IP65, but outdoor use needs the separate Wyze Universal Outdoor Power Adapter because the included cable is not outdoor-rated. As sold it is an indoor camera, so it is listed as indoor.

power.note: 6 ft USB-C to USB-A cable with a 5 V/2 A adapter.

localStorage.note: microSD card up to 512 GB, sold separately; supports 24/7 local recording.

subscription.value: Cloud backup and AI features (Cam Plus)
subscription.note: Product page: Cam Plus adds 60-day cloud video backup, AI Video Search and Descriptive Alerts; 30-day free trial, then $2.99 per month per camera.

summary: Wyze's Cam Pan v4 works with Alexa and Google Assistant over dual-band Wi-Fi, powered by USB-C, and needs no hub. It records 24/7 to a microSD card of up to 512 GB; cloud backup and AI search need a Cam Plus plan. Apple Home, SmartThings, Home Assistant and Matter aren't confirmed in Wyze's pages.
caveats: Cloud backup, AI Video Search and Descriptive Alerts need a Cam Plus plan ($2.99 per month per camera after a 30-day trial, per Wyze's product page).
Outdoor use needs the separate Wyze Universal Outdoor Power Adapter; the included cable is not outdoor-rated.
